/opt/ros/indigo/lib/libtf.so: undefined reference to `tf2::BufferCore::_allFramesAsDot() const'

to reproduce: create a workspace with the ros/velodyne repo and the ros/geometry_experimental repo, both of them checked out to the latest version.

I bisected on ros/geometry_experimental and I confirmed #74 is the culprit

resolution.quote:
I patched fix_84 for _allFramesAsDOT as well. 
...
yep that fixes it!

notes: Independent walk agrees with the specification. E1: issue #84 (fetched via gh api, body by bricerebsamen 2015-03-11T19:11:39Z) gives the error log and bisect; maintainer tfoote engaged. E2 step 1: two separately released packages - tf (binary /opt/ros/indigo/lib/libtf.so from ros/geometry; consumer confirmed by the reporter's comment "no I created a dedicated workspace in my home dir that contains only those 2 repos. So tf is pulled from `/opt/ros/indigo`") and tf2 (source overlay from ros/geometry_experimental). Step 2 does not stop it: the failing item is the exported symbol the consumer references across the library boundary; PR #74 (fetched) changed the declaration "-  std::string _allFramesAsDot() const;" -> "+  std::string _allFramesAsDot(double current_time = 0) const;" in tf2/include/tf2/buffer_core.h, and at 1.11.4 tf/src/tf.cpp line 441 still reads "return tf2_buffer_._allFramesAsDot();" (verified via raw.githubusercontent.com), so the wrong reference crosses the boundary, not a defect inside one unit. Steps 3/4: fix commit 04810475 (fetched, merge of PR #86 'Use overloading instead of default arguments') adds source-level overloads ("std::string _allFramesAsDot(double current_time) const;" plus "std::string _allFramesAsDot() const;"), an interface change, not name rebinding or build-only. Stop 6, library API. E3 UPGRADE fits: the binary consumer still references the element as declared at the earlier provider revision. Failed conditions: condition 0 (element_retyped) matches the fetched PR #74 diff exactly (declaration changed, element still present); condition 1 (element_removed_or_renamed) matches the ABI view - the zero-argument mangled symbol the consumer references is no longer exported (tfoote's nm output in the issue shows "U _ZNK3tf210BufferCore15allFramesAsYAMLEv" undefined for the analogous allFramesAsYAML). Two classes on one change from two levels is coherent and the spec's notes say so. Loudness: linker diagnostic at build from existing tooling = loud_documented/build, agree. Resolution observed: reporter confirmed "yep that fixes it!" (2025-03-12T01:23:13Z fetched, actual 2015-03-12) on fix_84 (de715513, second parent of merge 04810475, verified via commit API) with the unchanged indigo binary consumer.
